_comment: All gränssnittstext på engelska (DESIGN.md, Språk i gränssnittet). Förband, befattningar, grader och utmärkelser kommer från datafilerna på originalspråk. {namn} ersätts med värden.

meta.title: Byn vid fronten — tactical infantry battle
meta.description: Lead a German infantry platoon on the Eastern Front, 1943. Give orders, use cover and pause when you need to.

map.ariaLabel: Battle map. Select a unit with 1–4; press again to centre on it. Click the map to give the order. Arrow keys move the order cursor and Enter gives the order; Shift and arrow keys move the camera.

brief.title: Take the village crossroads.
brief.text: Lead your platoon forward and hold the farmyard by the objective flag for {hold} seconds. The enemy is defending the village.
brief.hint: Select a unit below. Click the map to give orders. Click a house to enter it. Space pauses.

panel.missionText: Hold the area with no enemy nearby.
panel.portraitLabel: Close-up of a soldier in the selected unit and his current posture

help.move: Click the ground to move, or a house to enter it through the door.
help.fast: Fast Move: click where to run. Faster, but easier to see and hit, and no fire readiness on the way.
help.crawl: Crawl: click where to crawl. Slow, but hard to see and hit; a pinned unit can still crawl.
help.position: Defend: the unit holds here with better cover. Click the map to move to a new defensive position.
help.fire: Fire: click a spotted enemy unit to concentrate fire on it. A Granatwerfergruppe fires indirectly at any point you click within its range.
help.sector: Cover Sector: drag from one edge of the arc to the other (or click for a 60° arc). The unit holds and fires only into the sector.

log.ready: {units} units ready. Give orders and start the battle.

toast.recovering: The unit is recovering and cannot take orders.
toast.unreachable: That place cannot be reached. Choose open ground or the middle of a house.
toast.mapFailed: The map image could not be loaded. Try reloading the page.
toast.dataFailed: Game data could not be loaded.
toast.graphicsFailed: The sprite graphics could not be loaded. Code-drawn graphics are used.
toast.confirmRestart: End this battle and start over?
toast.confirmGraphics: Changing graphics restarts the battle. Continue?
toast.cannotSplit: This unit cannot split. A Gruppe needs both its Gruppenführer and Truppführer to split.
toast.tooFarToMerge: The two Trupps are too far apart to merge. Move them together first.
toast.noTarget: Click a spotted enemy unit to fire on.

result.held: You held the objective for {hold} seconds.
result.wiped: All your units are out of action.
result.timeout: Time ran out before the objective was secured.

graphics.badge: WALK CYCLE V2 / FALLEN – NOT APPROVED

debug.title: DEBUG VIEW
debug.fireOn: Test fire on the cell. Start the battle to see the effect.
debug.on: Debug view on. Shift+click a cell for test fire.
debug.grenadePaused: Test grenade set. It goes off when the battle runs.

modeHelp.directFire: Units within the radius build fire readiness faster and hit better.
modeHelp.leadAssault: Units within the radius take orders faster, are slowed less by suppression and lose less cohesion from casualties.
modeHelp.rally: Units within the radius regain cohesion faster when out of fire – also broken units.

daredevil.name: Daredevil
daredevil.pro: Faster assault, breaks less easily when advancing
daredevil.con: Hard to pull back, heavier losses

veteran.name: Eastern Front Veteran
veteran.pro: Better in buildings and close combat

green.name: Green
green.con: Weak rally, can be pinned himself

mgSpecialist.name: MG Specialist
mgSpecialist.pro: Faster barrel change and MG readiness

forwardObserver.name: Forward Observer
forwardObserver.pro: Can call in artillery without an observer
forwardObserver.con: Needs line of sight and must stand still

purchase.intro: Choose the leaders of your platoon and buy reinforcements from the company and battalion. The budget cannot be exceeded.
purchase.coreText: The scenario gives you the platoon below. Its leaders are yours to choose.
purchase.leadersText: Two or three candidates for each leader position, with different rank, qualities and price. Hover a candidate to compare him with your current choice.
purchase.reinfText: Units available to the company and battalion in {year}.

reinf.de-gruppe-1943: A further rifle Gruppe from the company: MG 34 and nine men.
reinf.de-schwere-mg-gruppe-1943: A heavy MG 34 on its tripod mount from the machine-gun platoon. Long range and heavy suppression, but slow to set up.
reinf.de-granatwerfergruppe-1943: An 8 cm Granatwerfer 34. Indirect fire at a marked point within range – no line of sight needed.
